category_title: Students with learning disabilities who use abbreviations and pre-quizzes to prioritize lecture content
scenario_title: Note-taking during a 15-minute science video lecture
minimal_context: Noah is attempting to take notes on a blank piece of paper while watching a 15-minute video lecture on Electro-Plasma Rockets.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to watch this 15-minute video lecture on Electro-Plasma Rockets. Please take notes on the important points using your notebook paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: He's talking really fast. I'm trying to write these bigger sentences but it takes too much time.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep listening and write down what you hear.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know what the most important part of the topic is. I'm missing the clues about what I'm supposed to be paying attention to.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try your best to catch up and focus on the main ideas.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't do it. I'm writing too slow to understand the information from the lecture, and I have zero critical points written down so far.
